# Changelog

All notable changes to `drf-react-by-schema-agent-console` are documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

> Sections from the second release on are generated automatically by GitLab from the
> `Changelog:` commit trailers (see `AGENTS.md`, "Releases & changelog").

## 0.0.2 (2026-11-10)

### Fixed (1 change)

- [Show the package README on the npm package page](https://gitlab.com/eita/drf-react-by-schema/drf-react-by-schema-agent-console/-/commit/89a1cae19f68826974721a78b2a178363335fccd)

## 0.0.1 (2026-11-10)

### Added

- Initial extraction of CTA's Agent Console UI into a standalone npm package.
- `<AgentConsole />` panel and `<AgentPage />` (gate + shell + panel), `useAgentRuntime`,
  `defaultTexts` and `buildDefaultStyles(theme, { brandColor })`.
- CTA's newer generation as the default: grouped tool activity, copy + download reply
  action bar, bordered response card and the `toolStatus` labels.
- Full themeability: every style value is a MUI theme token or `brandColor`, with a
  deep-mergeable `styles` override and a `./styles` subpath export.

# API reference — `drf-react-by-schema-agent-console`

Canonical reference for everything the package exposes to **consuming apps**: the
`AgentConsole` panel, the `AgentPage` page, the `useAgentRuntime` hook, the default texts /
styles and their override surfaces.

The public surface is exactly what `src/index.ts` exports. If a symbol is not re-exported
there, it is internal — do not import it from a deep path
(`drf-react-by-schema-agent-console/dist/...`), because its signature may change without
notice.

The package does **not** depend on `drf-react-by-schema`: the host passes its own `usuaria`,
`isMobile`, gate function, texts, styles and (optionally) slots/shell.

---

## Golden rules

1. **The host installs the peers.** `@assistant-ui/react`, `@assistant-ui/react-markdown`,
   `@assistant-ui/react-opencode`, `remark-gfm`, `@mui/material`, `@mui/icons-material`,
   `react` and `react-dom` are peer dependencies and must be present in the consuming app.
2. **The browser only talks to the host's Django broker.** `brokerUrl` points at it; the
   package injects the host JWT (`getToken`, default `localStorage.token`) into every request.
3. **Theme through the MUI theme, not literals.** Default styles come from
   `buildDefaultStyles(theme, { brandColor })`; override a subset with the `styles` prop.
4. **Keep `texts` overrides small.** They deep-merge over pt-BR defaults.

---

## 1. `<AgentConsole />`

`src/components/AgentConsole.tsx` — the bare panel (no page chrome, no gate). Use it when you
want to place the chat inside your own layout.

Props = `AgentConfig` (`src/types.ts`) plus the drawer flags:

| Prop              | Type                   | Default                                     | Purpose                                              |
| ----------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `brokerUrl`       | `string`               | **required**                                | Base URL of the host's Django agent broker.          |
| `agent`           | `string`               | **required**                                | Agent name defined in the project's `opencode.json`. |
| `getToken`        | `() => string \| null` | `() => localStorage.getItem("token")`       | Reads the JWT injected into every broker request.    |
| `sessionsOpen`    | `boolean`              | `false`                                     | Whether the mobile sessions drawer is open.          |
| `onCloseSessions` | `() => void`           | `() => {}`                                  | Closes the mobile sessions drawer.                   |
| `texts`           | `AgentTextsOverride`   | pt-BR defaults                              | Deep-merged user-facing strings.                     |
| `styles`          | `AgentStylesOverride`  | `buildDefaultStyles(theme, { brandColor })` | Deep-merged style overrides.                         |
| `slots`           | `AgentSlots`           | package defaults                            | Replaceable renderers (see §4).                      |
| `brandColor`      | `string`               | `theme.palette.primary.main`                | Focus/selection accent.                              |
| `remarkPlugins`   | `AgentRemarkPlugins`   | `[remarkGfm]`                               | Remark plugins for assistant markdown.               |

## 2. `<AgentPage />`

`src/components/AgentPage.tsx` — the full page: the auth gate, the page shell and the panel.
It manages `sessionsOpen` internally and shows a mobile `History` action to open the sessions
drawer.

Props = all of `AgentConsole`'s (`AgentConfig`, minus `sessionsOpen`/`onCloseSessions`) plus:

| Prop              | Type                                       | Default                    | Purpose                                                 |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `usuaria`         | `AgentUser \| null`                        | —                          | Current user (host passes `useAPIWrapper().usuaria`).   |
| `canUseAssistant` | `(usuaria?: AgentUser \| null) => boolean` | `(u) => !!u?.is_superuser` | Gate; when false the page renders `deniedMessage`.      |
| `deniedMessage`   | `string`                                   | `texts.denied`             | Message shown when the gate fails.                      |
| `title`           | `string`                                   | `"Assistente"`             | Shell title.                                            |
| `icon`            | `ReactNode`                                | `<SmartToy />`             | Shell icon.                                             |
| `isMobile`        | `boolean`                                  | internal `matchMedia` hook | Mobile flag (host may pass `useAPIWrapper().isMobile`). |
| `renderShell`     | `(args: AgentShellArgs) => ReactNode`      | header row over the panel  | Page chrome around the panel.                           |

`AgentShellArgs` = `{ title: string; icon: ReactNode; actions?: ReactNode; children: ReactNode }`.
The default shell renders `styles.shellHeader` (icon + title + actions) above the panel.
`AgentPage` always wraps the panel in `styles.pageRoot` before handing it to `renderShell`, so
a host shell (e.g. CTA's `PageShell`) only adds the surrounding chrome.

## 3. `useAgentRuntime`

`src/hooks/useAgentRuntime.ts` — builds the opencode client (with the auth `fetch`) and wires
it to `useOpenCodeRuntime`.

| Option      | Type                       | Purpose                                 |
| ----------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `brokerUrl` | `string`                   | Base URL of the Django broker.          |
| `agent`     | `string`                   | Default agent name.                     |
| `getToken`  | `() => string \| null`     | JWT reader (default `defaultGetToken`). |
| `onError`   | `(error: unknown) => void` | Receives runtime errors.                |

Returns an `AssistantRuntime` (from `@assistant-ui/react`).

## 4. Slots (`AgentSlots`)

| Slot               | Type                           | Purpose                                                                |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ToolCallView`     | `ToolCallMessagePartComponent` | Rendered for every tool call.                                          |
| `UserMessage`      | `ComponentType`                | Rendered for user messages.                                            |
| `AssistantMessage` | `ComponentType`                | Rendered for assistant messages (markdown, tool activity, action bar). |
| `markdown`         | `AgentMarkdownComponents`      | react-markdown element overrides, merged over the defaults.            |

`markdown` merges one level deep: pass only the elements you want to replace (e.g.
`{ table: MyTable }`). Everything else keeps the default MUI mapping.

## 5. Texts (`AgentTexts`)

| Key                         | Default                                                                                                |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `newConversation`           | `"Nova conversa"`                                                                                      |
| `composerPlaceholder`       | `"Pergunte sobre os dados…"`                                                                           |
| `emptyTitle`                | `"Assistente"`                                                                                         |
| `emptyBody`                 | `"Faça perguntas sobre os dados desta aplicação. As respostas usam apenas a sua permissão de acesso."` |
| `send`                      | `"Enviar"`                                                                                             |
| `stop`                      | `"Parar"`                                                                                              |
| `conversations`             | `"Conversas"`                                                                                          |
| `copyReply`                 | `"Copiar resposta"`                                                                                    |
| `downloadMarkdown`          | `"Baixar em Markdown"`                                                                                 |
| `denied`                    | `"Apenas administradoras podem usar o Assistente."`                                                    |
| `toolStatus.error`          | `"erro"`                                                                                               |
| `toolStatus.running`        | `"executando…"`                                                                                        |
| `toolStatus.requiresAction` | `"aguardando"`                                                                                         |
| `toolStatus.incomplete`     | `"incompleto"`                                                                                         |
| `toolStatus.done`           | `"concluída"`                                                                                          |

The default export filename is `resposta_assistente_<timestamp>.md`.

## 6. Styles (`AgentStyles`)

`buildDefaultStyles(theme, { brandColor })` returns one object per key below. All values are
derived from theme tokens or `brandColor` — there are no hardcoded colors. The `styles` prop
is a partial of this shape and is deep-merged over the defaults (`markdown` one level deep).

| Key                                                                   | Kind | Notes                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pageRoot`                                                            | `sx` | Fixed viewport height minus the app chrome.                                                           |
| `layout`                                                              | `sx` | Session panel + chat panel row.                                                                       |
| `shellHeader`, `shellTitle`                                           | `sx` | Default `renderShell` header row.                                                                     |
| `sessionPanel`, `sessionListHeader`, `newThreadButton`, `sessionList` | `sx` | Desktop session list.                                                                                 |
| `chatPanel`                                                           | `sx` |                                                                                                       |
| `threadRoot`, `viewport`                                              | CSS  | Styled primitives (emotion, not the `sx` system).                                                     |
| `sessionButton`                                                       | CSS  | Focus outline uses `brandColor`.                                                                      |
| `composer`, `composerInput`                                           | CSS  | Border = `divider`, background = `background.paper`.                                                  |
| `sendButton`                                                          | `sx` |                                                                                                       |
| `actionBar`, `actionButton`                                           | CSS  | Reply action bar; focus outline uses `brandColor`.                                                    |
| `copiedIcon`                                                          | `sx` | Copy-confirmation check mark.                                                                         |
| `emptyState`                                                          | `sx` |                                                                                                       |
| `userRow`, `userBubble`                                               | `sx` |                                                                                                       |
| `assistantRow`, `responseCard`, `activityBlock`                       | `sx` | Bordered reply card + grouped tool activity.                                                          |
| `messageText`                                                         | `sx` |                                                                                                       |
| `toolCard`, `toolCardHeader`, `toolIcon`, `toolName`, `toolStatus`    | `sx` | Tool call chip.                                                                                       |
| `errorAlert`                                                          | `sx` |                                                                                                       |
| `drawerPanel`                                                         | `sx` | Mobile sessions drawer.                                                                               |
| `markdown.*`                                                          | `sx` | `paragraph`, `heading`, `list`, `listItem`, `link`, `codeInline`, `pre`, `blockquote`, `table`, `hr`. |

The same object is exported from the package root and from the `./styles` subpath
(`drf-react-by-schema-agent-console/styles`), for hosts that want to build on the defaults.
